title: What do you think of the Koi? - Koi Oasis
author: KoiOasis
selftext:
After four months of me working on Koi Oasis, Planet Zoo comes out with Koi... Seriously lol... Nonetheless, the project continues. I am in the middle of improving the Standard Koi. The fins are too paddle like, I'm improving those by making them thinner and translucent. but otherwise, how does my pre-alpha version look? Thanks for your help :)

Also, as I'm not looking to clog up this group with constant koi updates, if you're interested in following this project closely and giving feedback on the latest thing that I'm working on, join me on my new Discord channel:

[https://discord.gg/qAVRfA6jH](https://discord.gg/qAVRfA6jH)

Otherwise, I'll still post here periodically with updates looking for input.

Thank you for your assistance,

Scott

P.S. the water visuals will be improved in a couple months, so I apologize for the lighting and color of the water, that will be improved.
